remarks: Beautifully designed home blending craftsmanship, function & modern style. Features a double attached garage w/ floor drain, separate side entry, 9' ceilings & vinyl plank flooring through the main. Spacious foyer w/ lrg coat closet, 2-pc bath & mud rm w/ garage access leading to a walk-thru pantry. Open-concept kitchen, nook & great rm showcase quartz counters, central island w/ flush eating ledge, built-in microwave, Silgranit undermount sink, pendant lighting, Thermofoil cabinetry w/ raised profiles & soft-close doors/drawers, chimney hood fan & full-height tile backsplash. Bright great rm w/ cozy FP, lrg windows & sliding patio doors to backyard. Upstairs, the primary bedroom offers a 4-pce ensuite w/ dbl sinks & glass-enclosed W/I shower, plus W/I closet connecting to laundry rm w/ hall access. Two addl bdrms, 4-pc bath w/ dbl sinks, open-to-below views, upgraded railings, black plumbing & lighting fixtures, and bsmt rough-in pkg w/ 2nd laundry rough-in complete this home. (id:67522)
